title: Mask
description: Defines one multiplicative factor from the containing source expression to a target expression. All factors read one immutable pre-mask driver vector.

target.description: Index of the native expression driver attenuated by this mask.
target.gltf_detailedDescription: This value MUST be a valid index into the `expressions` array of the top-level `KHR_character_expression` extension object.

name.description: Diagnostic copy of the target expression label.
name.gltf_detailedDescription: When defined, this value MUST exactly and case-sensitively match the `expression` property referenced by `target`. Resolution MUST use `target`, not `name`.

type.description: Mask factor type. Standard values are 'blend' and 'block'. A custom value is shaped like a glTF vendor extension name and uses identity behavior unless a supported same-object companion extension defines one bounded factor.

amount.description: Attenuation amount used by the standard 'blend' and 'block' factors.

threshold.description: Strict source-driver threshold for a standard 'block' factor. The factor activates only when the source value is greater than this value.
